thread:
lisa: Heads-up — onboarding runner failed for alexa-mini-v2 when converting HF -> Redwood. saw auth 403 on hub fetch + safetensors shard index mismatch. stack below.

matt: ugh, 403 + shard mismatch together smells like a partial download + retry landed us with a two-file shard/idx out-of-sync. did the hub return a 200 for the index?

lisa: hub returned 200 for index.json, then convertbot tried to fetch `weights.safetensors` and got 403 on one of the shards. convertbot retried and downloaded a smaller file, which later caused the converter to map weight keys to wrong shard offsets.

convert-bot: [convert-run id=conv-2026-03-20-11-18] ERROR: safetensors: shard 3 length 0 != expected 23456789; weight key map produced negative offsets. rev pin: hf://org/alexa-mini@main -> resolved to commit abcdef.

anna: did the rev pin resolution happen before we validated archive integrity? we should checksum each shard before writing to cache.

kim: quick workaround: add `--strict-shard-check` to converter to bail on mismatch instead of attempting to remap keys. also reauth retry loop might be masking short-lived token flakiness.

josh: working on a proper fix — plan: 1) verify ETag/CID on download, 2) write to tmpfile then atomic rename, 3) compute safetensors index checksum and compare to index.json expected hash, 4) if mismatch, invalidate cred cache and re-fetch with fresh token.

matt: +1. also we saw weight key renames in the model config (legacy `lm_head` -> `lm_head_fused`) which our keymapper applied after mapping offsets; order-of-ops matters — we need to rename keys before distributing offsets to shards.

lisa: noted. another wrinkle: chat-template has special token sentinel `<|embed|>` in config.json. converter's tokenizer merger dropped it when tokenizer bytesize changed after quant-aware normalization. led to quant eval regressions in embedding alignment tests.

convert-bot: INFO: fallback route: remap to `alexa-mini-v2-int8` variant on capacity constraints. But we should not auto-fallback when shard integrity is suspect.

josh: I'll open a PR today with checksum+atomic write + rename-before-offset patch. will include a fail-fast flag and telemetry to record 'shard-mismatch' events.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-20T12:30Z once PR passes CI. tagging @kim @lisa for verification.

lisa: thanks — i'll run the embedding unit tests and the quant eval harness after staging deploy. if we still see the sentinel token missing, i'll paste failing prompt/response examples here. :thumbsup:
